design_notes: Use serif font throughout; single accent colour (e.g., dark blue) for table headers and pull-quote border.
Financials table: right-align numbers, left-align metric names; use hairline rules between rows.
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a left rule in accent colour; place after the opening paragraph.
Sidebar: box with thin border, light background tint; place after the 'The public offer' section.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The filing reveals a business that is deeply tied to government contracts, heavily dependent on a single customer, and carrying significant debt.
pull_quotes.quote: Western Railway alone contributed 52% of the orders on hand as of the filing date.
pull_quotes.rationale: Customer concentration is the single most important risk; this number is stark and memorable.
